items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: in '41 I went out on the road with Snub Mosely when the war broke out. See, it was '41 when the war broke out, and Snub Mosely was on the road with a USO show.

ctx.x: He told me a story about some band -- this was right in the early 20's, I think, maybe '25. He said there was a band (I can't remember), the Golden Something, out of Chicago or somewhere. They were down in Florida, and somebody accused one of the band of stepping out of line or peeking at his woman or something.
